purpose: For every consultant finding: CONSULTANT_FINDING -> SOURCE_CHECK -> INDEPENDENT_CALCULATION -> RECONCILIATION -> FINAL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_STATUS

reconciliation_statuses.CONFIRMED: Consultant finding verified against independent source
reconciliation_statuses.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Consultant finding partially verified; some aspects require correction
reconciliation_statuses.CONTESTED: Consultant finding contradicted by independent evidence
reconciliation_statuses.UNSUPPORTED: Consultant finding has no supporting evidence
reconciliation_statuses.UNKNOWN: Cannot be verified without further evidence
